title: Splitting a bill loses a cent
author: dana-lee
body:
Splitting 1.00 between three people charges 0.33 each, so one cent is never collected.

Steps: call checkout.split_bill(100, 3).
Expected: [34, 33, 33], as the README says.
Actual: [33, 33, 33].

comments.author: sam-ortiz
comments.body: Same here with split_bill(1000, 3): I get three shares of 333.

comments.author: maintainer-jo
comments.body: Leftover cents now go to the earliest shares on main. Closing.
